cb65425b-cc3d-4f8a-8164-5849f594d708.title: Build data by onboarding 5 additional customers
cb65425b-cc3d-4f8a-8164-5849f594d708.exec_summary: Goal: onboard the next 5 hand-picked customers and run AP & AR reconciliation on neno. The 6 Jul target has long passed and the build is now largely in customers' hands - which is exactly how the week's worst moment arrived. On 28 Jul the Home-hub demo task ("Laptop purchase - receipt needed") was found rendering inside the customer-facing BV incorporation checklist in the launch app, with a working Upload button, counted in the customer's completion readout: two real BV customers acted on it, one uploading a genuine Coolblue invoice on 27 Jul. Yaroslav cleared the bad onboarding tasks from the database - in time to spare a new paying BV customer - patched the provisioning code, closed it as NEO-1605 (urgent, Done 28 Jul), and called a retrospective for 29 Jul with Joel, Dima and Matthew, saying plainly that features with a wide blast radius are not being thought through. Alongside that, real progress: the Home onboarding hub was extended to Swan banking workspaces behind an admin-managed per-workspace toggle settable on accounting-engagement create and update (NEO-1577, Dima, Done 28 Jul), the sandbox WhatsApp number is configured with PR-preview routing (NEO-1581, Joel, Done 28 Jul, Meta bot setup still in progress), and the long-standing multi-workspace WhatsApp requirement finally has a ticket (NEO-1604, Joel) after First Ring was onboarded onto neno AP across two accounts. Open banking remains live for real customers (QLever from 23 Jul) and Dima keeps working the Open Banking frontend/ingestion pair. Watch-outs are unchanged and now joined by a bigger one: connected accounts still have no recurring daily fetch, the bankTransaction.reference schema change is outstanding, the Exact 60 req/min limit is unsolved, Ihor is away to 31 Aug and Mark to 7 Aug - and onboarding-actions provisioning has proven it can escape into the BV funnel.
whats_changed: WhatsApp: the sandbox account is configured (NEO-1581, Joel, Done 28 Jul) with a dedicated sandbox number and PR-preview message routing - Meta bot setup still in progress - and the multi-workspace destination prompt is now ticketed as NEO-1604 (Joel), prompted by First Ring onboarding onto neno AP across two accounts.

Home onboarding hub extended to Swan banking workspaces behind an admin-managed per-workspace switch (NEO-1577, Dima, Done 28 Jul): onboarding actions are enabled for Swan users with accounting engagements, the action set is segment-aware, and the Admin UI can toggle the feature per workspace on accounting-engagement creation and update.

The onboarding-actions demo task leaked into the BV incorporation flow (NEO-1605, urgent, Yaroslav, Done 28 Jul). The Home-hub sample task rendered in the customer-facing BV checklist in the launch app with a working Upload button and was counted in the "N/M van uw taken zijn voltooid" readout; two customers acted on it (one uploaded a real Coolblue invoice on 27 Jul) and Giuseppe reported the last two BV incorporations were both prompted. Yaroslav cleaned the database - clearing it before a new paying BV customer saw it - and patched the code. A retro with Joel, Dima and Matthew is set for 29 Jul.

New-signup capability grants bug fixed (NEO-1572, urgent, Joel, Done 27 Jul): every workspace membership created in prod since 19 Jul 22:08 UTC had its meta NULL, so all neno.* capabilities resolved false and new users were bounced off /dashboard/tasks to a blank dashboard - a customer got a daily open-task reminder he couldn't act on. fef38f90-b82c-4c47-b377-6dcb9b1a3020.title: Enable accountants to complete VAT submissions via double-entry GL

notes.text: Full specification for this build lives in the native-GL knowledgebase (an Obsidian vault) on PR #1128: the user-observable outcomes in 'General Ledger - Truth Conditions' (TC-LEDGER-01..15), the system rules in 'General Ledger - Invariants' (INV-LEDGER-01..22), and the architecture narrative in the 'General Ledger' domain hub. In-scope-now items (TC-LEDGER-01..06 / INV-LEDGER-01..13) read 'Holds'; deferred future-build items (TC-LEDGER-07..15 / INV-LEDGER-14..22) read 'Proposed (deferred)'.

The knowledgebase is a behavioural 'digital twin': Truth Condition -> Invariant -> Scenario -> test -> code, traceable by id (TC-/INV-/SCN-LEDGER-NN). Tests cite the scenario id they prove; code cites the invariant id it satisfies. Reading order is top-down from the domain hub.
Agentic-ledger idea: when a backdated entry is posted, automatically detect which reports are affected and surface the delta.

fef38f90-b82c-4c47-b377-6dcb9b1a3020.exec_summary: Neno's own double-entry general ledger has been live on production for Ocean Ionics since 21 Jul (NEO-1361 + NEO-1514, Mark) - the initiative's core milestone, reached before Mark's 23 Jul holiday. The ledger books three event types (bank transactions on arrival, bills on confirmation, transaction links/settlement); pre-existing OI bills and transactions raise expected Ledger Failures cleared with a bank-transaction backfill script, and the neno-vs-Exact trial-balance comparison page is still noisy on OI. With Mark away, the visible work has shifted to the accountant-facing coding layer: the Smart Bill Review GL/VAT proposal pipeline landed its core pieces 26-27 Jul, and on 28 Jul Art corrected a real weakness in it - the proposer was being asked to infer VAT treatment with the numbers withheld. Its prompt carried supplier name, line position and description plus the candidate code lists, but not net, gross, tax rate or the bill-level tax entries, so the model guessed the rate and whether amounts were inclusive or exclusive (visible on an Albert Heijn receipt offering both an exclusive and an inclusive low-rate code). NEO-1595 derives the rate and inclusive/exclusive treatment from the bill's own figures and narrows the candidates; PR #1266 closes the case Matthew raised the same day. Coding accuracy remains limited by the small set of historical supplier bookings (buying labelled datasets was floated, no decision). Open threads carried over: the FX balance rule, locked-period break-the-glass detail, foreign EU-paid VAT treatment, the FedEx BTW-return booking Exact refuses, and year-end roll-forward sign-off with DP.
whats_changed: Smart Bill Review VAT coding made arithmetic rather than guessed (NEO-1595, Art, In Review 28 Jul): the coding proposer's prompt withheld net, gross, tax rate and bill-level tax entries, so the model had to guess the VAT rate and inclusive/exclusive treatment - visible on an Albert Heijn receipt whose candidate menu offered both an exclusive and an inclusive low-rate code. The fix derives both from the bill's own figures and narrows the candidate list; PR #1266 closes the AH case Matthew raised the same day.

Smart Bill Review GL/VAT coding pipeline landed its core pieces (27 Jul): the proposal engine now runs as a pipeline step producing validated GL+VAT proposals or an abstention against the workspace's Exact code lists (NEO-1531/A2, Done 26 Jul); a broken proposer is now surfaced instead of silently abstaining (NEO-1567, Done 27 Jul); and a prod bug that left the bill detail page permanently read-only - Exact status fetched via a bare relative URL, so the GL/VAT pickers never mounted - was fixed (NEO-1578, Done 27 Jul). A training-data hurdle was raised (Art/Nick): accuracy is limited by the small historical-booking set, so buying labelled datasets was floated (no decision).

Smart Bill Review (Art): the bill-parsing model is being extended to recommend precise GL accounts and VAT codes to accountants from historical supplier bookings (Ocean Ionics VAT & GL code matching); ~70-80% accuracy on limited data. Open point: the same supplier is often booked to different GL accounts, so Matthew asked Andries for the additional line-item judgement logic. (24 Jul)

Neno Ledger LIVE on production for Ocean Ionics (21 Jul, Mark; NEO-1361 + NEO-1514): books bank transactions on arrival, bills on confirmation, and settlement links. Pre-existing OI data raises expected Ledger Failures cleared via a bank-transaction backfill script (Runbook); the neno-vs-Exact trial-balance page is noisy on OI for now.

Bill edit/re-book flow shipped (21 Jul): booking locks a bill's facts; an Edit action reverses the bill and any related settlement to release the evidence, and Re-book commits a fresh booking (multiple edits before commit) - the existing Exact sync is unaffected.

GL progress (16 Jul stand-up): trial-balance comparison page now drills each account into its individual ledger movements with T-account diagrams and counts only committed payments; a single shared 'ready to book' gate (GL account + representable VAT treatment + tax rate + correct currency) now runs everywhere from review to booking.

First production run planned as a validation-only trial (nothing operational depends on it): foreign bills pre-converted to EUR, bill-edit correction flow left unbuilt, ledger failures logged quietly. Outstanding balances read from postings, not a stored 'paid' flag.
GL target set: production before Mark's holiday (23 Jul). Ledger operating as expected; scope remains large; an immediate handoff would be rough but not impossible. (15 Jul stand-up)

decisions.text: Smart Bill Review VAT coding made arithmetic rather than guessed (NEO-1595, Art, In Review 28 Jul): the coding proposer's prompt carried the supplier name, each line's position and description and the two candidate lists, but withheld net, gross, tax rate and the bill-level tax entries - so the model had to guess the VAT rate and whether amounts were inclusive or exclusive. The fix derives the rate and inclusive/exclusive treatment from the bill's own figures and narrows the candidates accordingly; PR #1266 closes the Albert Heijn receipt case Matthew raised the same day.

Smart Bill Review GL/VAT coding pipeline landed its core pieces: the proposal engine runs as a pipeline step that persists a validated GL+VAT proposal (or an abstention) per bill line, checked against the workspace's Exact code lists (NEO-1531/A2, Done 26 Jul); a broken proposer is now surfaced instead of silently abstaining (NEO-1567, Done 27 Jul); and a prod bug that left the bill detail page permanently read-only was fixed - BillDetailContent fetched Exact status with a bare relative URL, hit app.neno.co in production, got the SPA index.html and concluded Exact was disconnected, so the GL/VAT pickers never mounted (NEO-1578, Done 27 Jul).

Training-data hurdle for GL/VAT suggestions raised (Art/Nick): coding accuracy is limited by the small set of historical supplier bookings, so buying labelled datasets was floated as a way to improve the proposer - no decision.

Smart Bill Review GL/VAT coding assistance (Art): the bill-parsing model is being extended to present precise GL-account and VAT-code recommendations to accountants, learned from historical supplier bookings (Ocean Ionics VAT & GL code matching); ~70-80% accuracy on limited data. Hurdle: the same supplier is often booked to different GL accounts, so Matthew asked Andries whether accountants apply additional line-item logic. Addresses the earlier gap that GL account/VAT code were never suggested in bill review.

GL build progress (Mark): the trial-balance comparison page now expands each account into its individual ledger movements and draws the booking history behind a reconciled payment as T-account diagrams; the breakdown was fixed to count only payments actually committed to the ledger (a part-matched payment no longer looks booked); a single shared 'ready to book' check (GL account + a representable VAT treatment + a tax rate + the correct currency) now runs from review through approval to booking, replacing several disagreeing copies; an independent review confirmed the ledger uses only its own vocabulary.

First production run planned as a validation-only trial nothing operational depends on: foreign bills convert to euros before booking, the bill-edit correction flow stays unbuilt (drift repaired by hand, even by wiping and re-booking the trial ledger), and ledger failures are logged quietly instead of paging on-call.

Outstanding-balance tracking specced: read what is still owed on each bill/invoice straight from the postings rather than storing a separate 'paid' flag (prompted by a part-paid bill showing as fully settled).
GL target: production before Mark's holiday (from ~23 Jul); trial-balance comparison page verifies neno-vs-Exact sync; knowledgebase is the handoff vehicle for new engineers.

VAT is attributed in full to the period the invoice was issued, even when the underlying expense is recognised across multiple periods (subscriptions spread the expense, never the VAT); non-EU regimes (e.g. South Africa) out of scope for current VAT logic.

Settlement amount validation (Decision 08 / INV-30): reconciliation checks amount, not just zero-balance - the bank-entry leg and the bill leg must match on amount before reconciling; correspondence is re-checked when a bill is edited after initial booking.
Decision 07 (editing open periods) covers deliberate 'break the glass' edits made during an open period only; edits outside a period are a separate concept - adjustments.
INV-11 confirmed: no separate GL account per counterparty - a payables GL account with a counterparty property, keeping a single account balance sliceable by counterparty.

VAT recognition: when an invoice's expense is split across periods (e.g. Mar-Apr-May), the full VAT amount books to the balance sheet (VAT reclaimable/payable) on the invoice date - VAT is not split monthly with the expense.

FX rate is booked at the ECB daily reference (mid) rate on the transaction date, frozen on the line; when the settling payment clears at a different rate the residual is a realised FX gain/loss posted to a dedicated FX-difference account, and a separate bank FX fee books to bank charges.
decisions.source: Granola - DP/Mark open questions neno GL, 30 Jun / Slack #accounting-mvp, 1 Jul

decisions.text: FX representation: every line stores native amount + transaction-date rate, reporting-currency value derived (INV-LEDGER-23); multi-currency balancing split to INV-LEDGER-27; INV-01 reworded so balance = signed sum of reporting-currency values. FX revaluation (INV-16, deferred): balance-sheet accounts only, revalue to period-end rate, true-up to FX result, USD bank first, on demand.

Locked-period corrections: correct-forward by default; restating a closed period only via a break-the-glass unlock (deliberate, per-workspace approver, full audit log, amount-threshold alerting); prompt when a correction hits an already-filed period.

VAT corrections are always corrected forward; two VAT balance-sheet accounts (normal + corrections/control); once the EUR 1,000 cumulative threshold is crossed all subsequent corrections route to the corrections account until the suppletie is filed. <EUR 1,000 net/year rolls into the next return, >EUR 1,000 goes on a supplementary return.

GL status: design locked and a first implementation drafted with passing unit tests, but not yet run against real production data - next step is feeding real prod data through the engine in dev (may surface code/architecture changes). Still the architecture/spike phase.

decisions.text: Native GL (NEO-1361) is implemented and green-tested behind an off-by-default feature flag; Neno owns the chart and VAT codes and Exact becomes a removable downstream sync - superseding the dual-write spike.

Ledger architecture: every accounting action emits an event; a reliable engine books each into a balanced, VAT-aware journal entry with counterparty and VAT-code dimensions; entries reference their event + source; corrections are append-only contras.
VAT is a first-class dimension: VAT code on base and tax lines; treatment (domestic / reverse-charge / intra-EU / import / export) drives the posting shape; the return maps codes to boxes.
'Source of truth' reworded to 'source of truth for VAT filing' to avoid scope creep from external payment sources.
Book ledger entries when bank transactions import (not only bills/invoices) so the bank balance is knowable before reconciliation (cash completeness via suspense).
Euro-only for now; XBRL statutory filing deferred. Opening balances at go-live handled via a backfill or a cutoff booking.

VAT corrections after a period close are booked in the next period (dated day 1); under EUR 1,000 fold into the next return without a supplemental filing. Balance sheet needs three VAT lines: receivable, payable, corrections/suspense.
Closed periods lock writes by default; unlocking is approval-gated and only for material post-close accruals; insert-only with full audit log.
Insert-only ledger with reversals - no edits to journal entries; corrections reverse and rebook. Period closes define immutability. Monitoring over rollback. Euro-only, multi-currency deferred.

Neno Ledger went live on production for Ocean Ionics (NEO-1361 + NEO-1514): it books bank transactions on arrival, bills on confirmation, and transaction links (settlement); pre-existing bills/transactions raise expected Ledger Failures handled via a bank-transaction backfill script (Runbook 'Settlement upstream leg is not live'); the neno-vs-Exact trial-balance comparison page is not yet useful on OI due to data noise.

Bill edit/re-book after booking: because the ledger locks a booked bill's facts, an Edit button books a reversing entry for the bill and any related settlement to release the evidence, and a Re-book button commits a fresh booking; multiple edits are allowed before re-booking and the existing Exact sync flow is unaffected.

open_questions.text: INV-30: exactly how the reconciliation imbalance occurred mechanically is still unclear (context in the Claude session).
OQ1 party definition: needs a formal write-up with decisions and reasoning (logic exists, no formal doc yet).
INV-23 label: 'multi-currency payments' wording in the summary doc is confusing - foreign lines keep native amount/currency/rate from day one, FX settlement deferred; doc to be reworded.

FX balance rule not finally chosen: 'signed sum zero in the entry's one currency' (spike model) vs 'signed sum of reporting-currency values is zero' (native multi-currency); also confirm the full residual account set (FX difference, rounding, payment difference, discount).

Locked-period break-the-glass details unsettled: who approves, what is recorded, and whether the original filing must be resubmitted; plus the audit-log + Slack unlock-alerting design (start by reporting all changes, add amount thresholds once noisy).
Year-end roll-forward (close income/expense into retained earnings; clean new-year P&L + correct opening balance sheet) flagged CORE but still needs DP sign-off.
Belgium gapless-ledger requirement - does it constrain day-to-day ledger architecture or only closed-period exports/reporting?
Full reporting requirements list (potentially 100+ items) still being compiled by DP.
VAT filing period must be configurable per customer/country (monthly, quarterly, or bi-monthly).

Foreign EU-paid VAT: bills with e.g. 10% Spanish IVA are booked at 0% in Exact (VAT paid in-EU), hiding the foreign VAT; as clients expand abroad (Ocean Ionics Spain) should neno track it (e.g. on an IVA GL account, or via 'Teruggaaf btw uit andere EU-landen 2008/9/EG' for goods)? Advice requested from DP (ref SCN-BILLS-084).
FedEx BTW-return bill: Exact will not accept the BTW (VAT) return booking directly; Andries proposes a dedicated GL account for these cases - to be confirmed.

next_steps.text: Production go-live done (ledger live for Ocean Ionics, 21 Jul); now triage the backfill/Ledger Failures on OI, keep the neno-vs-Exact trial balance under watch, and harden the bill-edit/re-book correction flow during Mark's leave.

NEO-1464 invariant: a bill must be extraction-approved (REVIEWED) before reconciliation; the legacy APPROVED status is to be removed. Not an active incident; prioritised for the week of 13 Jul.
Reconciliation review lists are now trustworthy: all bills/transactions properly surfaced (minor DB anomalies under investigation); duplicate-entry fix reviewed by Mark (2-3 issues caught, resolved).
Reconciliation suggestions limited to one active suggestion per bill and per transaction (NEO-1451 shipped); the same constraint will likely be needed for AR reconciliation once it exists.
Workflow: once the 'Not matched' and 'Needs your review' lists are trustworthy, Andries reviews the ~55 not-matched transactions and triggers missing-bill tasks for Marloes.

Depreciation schedules and credit-note processing deprioritised for July - moved back to Later on the board and Backlog in Linear (Andries' 6 Jul depreciation-schedule request noted; deprioritised regardless).
'Depreciation & accruals' split into 'Depreciation schedules' (was committed, then deprioritised) and 'Accruals' (Backlog, not committed); requirements retagged.
OI duplicate bank transactions fixed (NEO-1448); durable fix is NEO-1299 (pull bank transactions from Exact and suppress already-booked ones).
Three of the next-5 cohort run payroll that currently needs a manual monthly CSV import from Numbrs; payroll-integration viability for Q3 to be determined.
Aged-receivables analysis (by customer, 30/60/90/120+ day buckets) is a minimum AR reporting requirement.
Q3 goal restated: 30 customers running on neno for bookkeeping, with neno as the single source of truth feeding Exact.
Intercompany interest auto-accrual deprioritised as a nice-to-have (currently tracked in Excel).
Depreciation review runs in July and annually for now; year-end balance correctness is the key requirement (monthly journals possible in Exact).

Neno's double-entry ledger reached production for Ocean Ionics (see the double-entry GL initiative) - the foundation for neno holding the books; source-of-truth bookkeeping features build on top of it.

open_questions.text: Which two upcoming book-keeping features/integrations are prioritised first, and what are their requirements? Matthew was preparing this on 28 Jul.
Payroll design not yet discussed - remains an open design area for a future session.
Full reporting requirements list still being compiled by DP.
Feature sequencing and ownership for the post-GL bookkeeping scope is not yet decided.
Ocean Ionics Espana: separate entity or a second bank account? Booking treatment (intercompany vs investment) depends on the answer.
VAT filing period flexibility (monthly/quarterly/bi-monthly) must be configurable per customer and country.
Accountant portfolio management (per group/entity): where should it live (Yaroslav proposes Atlas) and what data source backs it?

Accept hybrid data and a longer Exact dependence for more customers to prioritise spend-management (in-app invoice payment/scheduling), or hold the line on book-keeping completeness first? To be decided as August joiners arrive.
When will a direct neno invoicing API be available? A reseller-style prospect's decision to use the Wefact bridge now or wait depends on the roadmap timeline.

next_steps.text: Sync on the end-to-end AR surfaces (PR #1232) to confirm they meet the requirements before building further.
Send Bjorn (Smart Data Solutions) a proposal covering how the Wefact invoicing route would work now and when direct neno API integration is expected, so he can decide whether to proceed or wait.
Grab CSV examples from Numbrs customers to understand the payroll reconciliation shape.
Prioritise NEO-1464 (review-before-reconciliation) - Yaroslav next week unless Joel has time sooner.
Resolve the remaining minor DB anomalies behind the reconciliation review lists.
Review the ~55 not-matched transactions and mark them receipt-missing / trigger tasks.
Compile the full reporting requirements list.
Define and file the remaining projects after end-to-end AR reconciliation.

meetings.title: Bjorn - Neno Invoicing connect
meetings.summary: Smart Data Solutions (Dutch HR sick-leave/absenteeism SaaS) wants to pass company name, registration number and employee count into neno by API so invoices generate automatically from a tiered price list (end customer / reseller / distributor brackets, fixed base plus per-employee variable), with volumes shifting monthly. EUR only today; GBP/USD/CHF planned for UK and South Africa expansion. One live customer, invoiced manually in the interim.
decisions: Wefact as the interim bridge: API-based, supports variable invoicing, used by around 30% of neno customers and integrated with neno bookkeeping, so neno keeps full visibility and data access. Direct neno API integration stays on the roadmap.
open_questions: Proceed with Wefact now or wait for direct neno API integration - Bjorn's own CRM and API capability are not ready yet
When direct neno API integration will be available (roadmap timeline TBD)
next_steps: Matthew to send Bjorn a proposal covering how the Wefact integration would work now and when direct neno API integration is expected

meetings.title: Workload Distribution: next customer cohort (tldv)
meetings.summary: Selective transaction sync to Exact agreed for the next cohort (hybrid data accepted, not urgent before end of August; 8 customers with 12 payroll payments to selectively push). Customers move to neno invoicing in phases; some will resist due to existing workflows.
decisions: Selective sync of transactions to Exact for the next cohort
Phased migration to neno invoicing, easiest lift first
next_steps: Yaroslav reviews IBAN-in-invoice complexity
Matthew phases customers onto neno invoicing

meetings.title: Sil x Yaroslav API call (tldv)
meetings.summary: Prospective customer Sil (software agency, sole proprietorship moving to a BV) wants agent-driven accounting: MCP/API access for quotes and invoices, email-forwarded invoice ingestion, and quarterly audits of transactions missing documentation. Yaroslav positioned neno's MCP approach and the proprietary GL (Exact proxy phased out end of year).
decisions: Expose an MCP server for invoice and quote operations
Add non-reconciled items + missing documents lists to the roadmap
next_steps: Sil engages as first customer for invoice API testing

meetings.title: Daily stand up
meetings.summary: Reconciliation: duplicate-entry fix reviewed by Mark (2-3 issues caught, resolved); AR will likely need the same duplicate-suggestion fix once it exists (ticket filed). Stand-up notes: Swan transactions syncing into Xero for 3 workspaces via the per-workspace connections pipeline; 163 backlog Q2 invoices bulk-uploaded via a Claude-assisted harness; invoice/billing flow needs a proper fix before customer count scales.
next_steps: Matthew sends the credit-transfer screenshot to Ihor to reproduce locally
